title: Multiple Classes – Student Auto-Assignment – Student in Two Assigned Classes – Single Student Session Created (No Duplicate)
description: AC 01.3/LT-99546 — Regression Analysis — Validates that when a student is in both assigned classes, only one Student Session is created and LA is incremented by 1.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Class Alpha: Student X + 2 others; Class Beta: Student X + 1 other
- Lesson "Lesson MC-Dedup" created with both classes; batch completed
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-Dedup"
2. Search for Student X in the list
3. Count total Student Sessions on the lesson
4. Open the Lesson Allocation for Student X
5. Read the "Lesson Allocated" count
steps_result:
1. Student Session list displayed
2. Student X appears exactly once (no duplicate)
3. Total sessions = 4 (Student X + 2 from Class Alpha + 1 from Class Beta)
4. Student X's LA opened
5. "Lesson Allocated" incremented by exactly 1 (not 2)

title: Multiple Classes – Student Auto-Assignment – Individual Assign on Contact Page – Student Added to Matching Lessons
description: AC 02.1 (BR-12) — Decision Table — Validates that assigning a class to a student individually via Contact page auto-assigns the student to all lessons that have that class via LSC.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Lesson "Lesson MC-01" has Class Alpha via LSC
- Student Y not yet in Class Alpha; has active LA for the course
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Student Y's Contact page in SF
2. Use "Assign Class" action to assign Student Y to Class Alpha
3. Save the assignment
4. Wait up to 2 minutes for auto-assignment batch to complete
5. Navigate to Student Session related list on "Lesson MC-01"
6. Search for Student Y
steps_result:
1. Contact page displayed
2. Assign Class form opens
3. Student Y added to Class Alpha
4. Batch completes
5. Student Session list displayed
6. Student Session for Student Y present on "Lesson MC-01"
